There's an automatic "wip(edit)" commit mechanism in this environment that commits each edit tool call! Interesting. So the tree moves with each edit, autocommitted. The user's instructions said starting commit fc0dd94. But the harness apparently auto-commits edits. So final tree state matters, not relative to HEAD. Good. The command_validate.cc edit apparently wasn't auto-committed (staged), and pass_jsonl_empty.sh edit auto-committed. Weird inconsistency, but whatever.

Wait, but this mechanism means `git show HEAD:src/logger.h` includes changes because my edit got committed. Fine. So my edits are present. Good.

Note: there's a possibility that submit's "tree unchanged from starting commit" check compares to the capture point. We have changes anyway.

Now, the important thing: build and test. Let's check Makefile and build dir. Also run clang-format.

Let's look at Makefile targets and pinned command.
